action_summary: Measure the creature against a held-out frontier instead of against its own fixtures (K3=0, $0 spend): a new oracle-judged benchmark (canonical/evaluation/frontier_bench_v1.py) generates instances from a seed for all six capability classes it claims -- isomorphic plan transfer, program synthesis (witness inversion), computer-use grounding, multi-file SWE repair, AGM belief revision / Sybil-echo defense, and cross-language Meaning-IR rule transfer -- and judges each one with an independent oracle: breadth-first search over an explicit machine, a second evaluator of the synthesised program's language, direct reads of the bytes the engine claims to have written, a subprocess that runs the repaired repository's own unittest suite, explicit root-lineage counting for epistemic entrenchment, and a truth-table comparison for transferred predicates.
